en.headline: John Lee announces green shipping corridor with Greece's Port of Piraeus
en.dek: The Chief Executive said the new partnership is a significant step for decarbonising Asia-Europe routes, with further deals planned with mainland ports.
body: Chief Executive John Lee announced on Monday the establishment of a green shipping corridor between Hong Kong Port and the Port of Piraeus in Greece. Speaking at the World Maritime Merchants Forum during Hong Kong Maritime Week, he described the collaboration as a landmark step toward reducing emissions on major shipping routes linking Asia and Europe.

Lee said Hong Kong would also form a dedicated task force to develop a green-fuel trading platform for the industry. He added that the city planned memorandums of understanding with Hainan and with Zhanjiang in Guangdong to build partner-port relationships and a green energy corridor, connecting fuel production on the mainland with international maritime markets.

The announcements came as Lee positioned Hong Kong as a stable base for ship owners amid geopolitical uncertainty. He noted the city is home to around 1,200 port and maritime-related companies and said it would continue to pursue high-value maritime services, digitalisation and autonomous shipping suited to local waters.

zh.headline: 李家超宣布與希臘比雷埃夫斯港建立綠色航運走廊
zh.dek: 行政長官指新合作是推動亞歐航線減碳的重要一步，並將與內地港口簽署進一步協議。
body: 行政長官李家超周一宣布，香港港口與希臘比雷埃夫斯港將建立綠色航運走廊。他在香港海運週期間的世界海運商人論壇上表示，這項合作是推動亞歐主要航線減碳的重要里程碑。
李家超說，香港將成立專責小組，為業界發展綠色燃料交易平台。他又指，本港計劃與海南及廣東湛江簽署備忘錄，建立夥伴港口關係及綠色能源走廊，將內地生產的燃料與國際海運市場連接。
有關宣布正值李家超強調香港在地緣政治不明朗下可為船東提供穩定基地。他指出，本港約有1200家與港口及海事相關的公司，並將繼續推動高增值海事服務、數碼化及適合本地水域的自主航運。
